title: LA City General Fund postings, January 2026 vs January 2025

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a significant increase in January 2026 compared to January 2025, with a 1.6% increase in January 2026. This increase is primarily attributed to Non-Departmental - Liability Claims, which saw a 443.3% increase in postings from $28.3m to $19.0m. The increase in Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration is also significant, with a 312.0% increase from $4.6m to $19.0m. The increase in City Clerk is also substantial, with a 13.6% increase from $1.1m to $13.5m. The decrease in Fire is also notable, with a 5.1% decrease from $84.6m to $74.5m.

final_text: General Fund postings were $928.1m in January 2026, up 1.6% from $913.6m in January 2025. Year-to-date postings were $5.16bn, up 3.9%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - Liability Claims increased by $23.1m; Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration increased by $14.4m; City Clerk decreased by $12.4m.
